sm_top.sm: Explosions were reported on Qeshm Island and Bandar Abbas in Iran following a US strike.
The U.S. plans to cut a $4 billion military aid package to Israel by the end of the year.
Iran's IRGC claims four oil tankers were destroyed by naval mines south of the Strait of Hormuz.
The US approved a possible foreign military sale of Patriot PAC-3 missiles to Ukraine.
Russian forces bombed a school used as an aid distribution point in Komyshuvakha, killing at least 33 people.
Russian forces used a ceasefire in Oleshky to bring in troops and ammunition.
A vessel was struck by an unknown projectile near the Strait of Hormuz, with 25 crew members evacuated by Oman.
Russia launched massive missile and drone strikes targeting Ukrainian energy infrastructure, causing casualties and power outages.
Massive drone attacks targeted Moscow and other Russian regions, resulting in widespread interceptions by Russian air defenses and flight disruptions.
The Israeli army withdrew from Hebron following a military operation.
Israeli strikes killed four Palestinians in Gaza.
Sudan accused Ethiopia of launching 162 drone attacks targeting infrastructure, resulting in 502 deaths.
Tankers exploded in the Strait of Hormuz after striking naval mines.
A Russian strike on a hospital in Kharkiv injured 73 people.
The United States deployed a Patriot missile defense system and refueling aircraft to Israel.
A bomb attack in western Colombia killed four people, including an infant.
Ethiopia has taken delivery of 12 Russian Su-35 fighter jets and is set to receive S-400 air defense systems.
Drone attacks struck power stations across Sudan, triggering widespread outages.
A U.S. official stated that the U.S. has conducted defensive strikes on Iranian targets in the Strait of Hormuz.
Ukrainian forces launched a drone strike hitting a Russian oil refinery.
Russian forces launched a massive combined strike with hundreds of missiles and drones targeting Ukraine's energy infrastructure.
Russian strikes on Dnipro killed two people and injured 20 others, damaging residential and medical facilities.
Iran's IRGC states that four tankers were destroyed by naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz.
A Russian drone strike killed a 13-year-old girl near a Vinnytsia school dormitory.
A Russian strike on a Ukrainian aid center killed at least 31 people and left dozens missing.
An employee at the Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant was killed in a drone attack.
At least 19 people were killed as the Venezuelan military attacked a Colombian rebel camp.
Myanmar military airstrikes hit a maternity clinic and school, killing 15 people including a newborn.
US forces launched a strike on Qeshm Island following an incident involving an American drone.
President Trump confirmed that the U.S. struck an Iranian facility.
Russian forces attacked an energy facility in Khmelnytskyi Oblast, causing power cuts.
The WHO chief reported that attacks in Ethiopia killed civilians and pushed the health system near collapse.
Russian air defense systems intercepted and destroyed 709 Ukrainian drones overnight across multiple regions and surrounding seas.
A drone strike hit a gas station in South Kordofan, killing at least 7 civilians and injuring 36 others.
Russia launched its biggest mass attack on Ukraine's energy infrastructure this year, hitting a substation critical for a nuclear power plant, and struck a Kharkiv medical facility
Dozens remain missing following a deadly Russian guided-bomb attack in southern Ukraine.
TEC-5 Thermal Power Plant in Kharkov City struck by Russian ballistic missiles and glide bombs.
A Houthi missile strike on a health center in Yemen resulted in multiple deaths and injuries.
Saudi airstrikes hit a Yemeni port and oil facility, wounding seven people.
Three Kyiv combined heat and power plants (TEC-5, TEC-6, and Darnitska TEC) stopped generating electricity due to shelling.
